summary: cro checked in 2 executive handoff item(s)

items.title: Prototype document-to-Markdown content normalization for one SEO workflow
items.summary: Test whether Microsoft MarkItDown can reduce manual normalization of one already-authorized source document into reviewable Markdown suitable for an existing content workflow. GitHub evidence: microsoft/markitdown, MIT license, 194 files, 22 purpose-keyword hits, 8 bounded checks passed, dependency installation not performed, production access false. This is capability evidence only, not proof of content quality, SEO lift, or maintenance fitness.
items.requested_action: After a delivery slot clears, ask CTO to validate an isolated prototype using one existing non-sensitive document and compare output against the current manual artifact. Do not add it to production, install dependencies in the fleet, ingest new sources, or publish generated content without normal review.

items.title: Prototype one accessible CTA component for reusable fleet UX
items.summary: Use shadcn/ui as a reference for a single reusable CTA treatment, tested only in an isolated preview against an existing surface such as the deferred 0xroulette.com CTA hypothesis. GitHub evidence: shadcn-ui/ui, MIT license, 3,198 files, 10 purpose-keyword hits, 3 bounded checks passed, dependency installation not performed, production access false. This is a design-system hypothesis, not an adoption approval.
items.requested_action: After capacity clears and overlapping site work is complete, have CTO validate a dependency-free or explicitly approved component extraction in an isolated preview. Compare accessibility, visual consistency, bundle impact, and CTA interaction evidence before considering implementation.
